text:
deploy-bot: config deploy requested by @mike for change window 21:00-22:00 UTC (today). config-only: routing weights + batching window. canary: 5% for 30m. dry-run passed. runbook: https://go/runbooks/config-patch-gatekeeper :robot_face:
alyssa: quick ask — can we get the exact diff? only want minimal surface area for tonight. :eyes:
mike: paste below (yaml). tiny change: reduce batching.window from 50ms -> 30ms, lower tenant_weight for fallback route, add soft-rate-limit 120rps
```
service:
  batching:
    window_ms: 30
  routing:
    fallback_route_weight: 0.08
  limits:
    soft_rate_limit_rps: 120
```
sara: ack but request pin for the model variant used on canary (v2f-2026-03-15). don't want autoswitch during canary if a newer variant is promoted.
ops_jen: +1 on pin. also add obs check for kv-cache hit/drop and tail-latency 95p. I'll run preflight smoke at 20:30 UTC.
alyssa: can we gate the rollout by error-rate <0.5% and p95 latency delta <15ms vs baseline? prefer manual promotion after canary.
mike: done — updated rollout plan to manual promote. deploy-bot will hold after canary and wait for approval. attaching quick notes:
- canary targets 5% traffic for 30m
- hold for ops approval + perf checks
- rollback on errors >0.5% or p95 delta >15ms
monitoring-bot: perf alert rules created for this thread: ALRT-3872 (p95 delta), ALRT-3873 (5xx spike), ALRT-3874 (kv-cache-drop). Will post summaries every 5m during canary.
ops_jen: preflight completed at 20:32 UTC. smoke commands: `curl -H "x-tenant: test-1" https://api.redwood/v1/infer` returned 200 and p95 ~ 50ms. ready to start canary at 21:00.
mike: starting canary now @deploy-bot start --thread 1795551234 --canary 5 --hold-after 30m --pin v2f-2026-03-15
deploy-bot: canary started: id=cfg-canary-179555, canary_percent=5, pinned_model=v2f-2026-03-15, hold_after=30m. posting periodic status.
monitoring-bot: t+5m: p95 +3ms, errors 0.07%, kv-cache drop steady. no alerts.
monitoring-bot: t+15m: p95 +12ms, errors 0.12%, kv-cache drop small. no alerts.
monitoring-bot: t+28m: p95 +18ms, errors 0.6% (spike), kv-cache drop increased. firing ALRT-3873 (5xx spike) + ALRT-3872 (p95 delta).
alyssa: seeing the ALRTs. mike, ops_jen — recommend abort and rollback. :warning:
mike: I'm seeing increased tail in traces pointing to fallback-route pressure. rolling back now. @deploy-bot rollback cfg-canary-179555
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for cfg-canary-179555. rolling canary back to previous config. ETA ~2m.
monitoring-bot: post-rollback t+4m: p95 back to baseline, errors 0.02%, kv-cache drop normalized.
ops_jen: nice call. documenting root cause as routing fallback weight interaction under small capacity tenants. will open a follow-up ticket for staged ramp testing and add a safety patch to avoid simultaneous weight+batching changes.
sara: can we re-run with a narrower change set? maybe only batching window first, then routing weight in a separate deploy. also keep pin.
alyssa: agreed. next attempt: batching-only at 2% canary, 30m, manual promote. mike, can you prepare that patch and schedule tomorrow morning change window? prefer daytime for easier ops support.
mike: on it. will push new PR and link here once ready. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: thread closed (canary rolled back). next action: waiting for updated PR and reschedule. reference: https://go/changes/PR-12345
